**Paperhue** is the free Windows app for ULANI e-paper devices
(ULANI 永恆曆).

Paperhue puts your own photos on a ULANI 7-colour e-paper device.
Pick up to four photos, see how each one will look in the panel's seven
colours, and send them to the device over Bluetooth. No account, no cloud.

## Download

Download **Paperhue.exe** below and double-click it. There is nothing to
install.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11 with Bluetooth LE.
- A ULANI 7-colour e-paper device, paired with the PC once (see
  [First-time setup](https://github.com/markhhm/ulani-epaper#first-time-setup)).
- The app's screens are in Traditional Chinese; the
  [README](https://github.com/markhhm/ulani-epaper#readme) gives the English
  meaning of every label.

## First run

Paperhue.exe is not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your
PC" the first time. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## Upgrading

If you used an earlier version of this app, delete its .exe and use
Paperhue.exe instead. Your device stays paired with the PC, so there is
nothing to set up again. The command-line tool is no longer shipped as an
.exe; developers can install it with the Python package (see the README).
